title: &, *, ( and )
intro: Keys this course has not used yet: &, *, ( and ). Each of them is Shift plus a key your fingers already know — Shift with the little finger of the other hand.
congrats: &, *, ( and ): under your fingers now. Shift with the other hand, and a symbol comes as easily as the letter beside it.

screens.text: & belongs to your right index finger, with Shift held by the other hand.
& on its own first, then where it is actually used.
screens.content:

&& & say & open plays & ahead who & run

screens.text: * belongs to your right middle finger, with Shift held by the other hand.
* on its own first, then where it is actually used.
( belongs to your right ring finger, with Shift held by the other hand.
( on its own first, then where it is actually used.
) belongs to your right little finger, with Shift held by the other hand.
) on its own first, then where it is actually used.
A burst of short pieces with these characters in them.
Words again, with the symbols where they belong.
